audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0-2].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' but content win[0-2] and win[6] read 'Lulu' — the chart contradicts itself.
audit.why: Content layer's whys already correctly explain a Lulu-favored level 1-3 (range/poke advantage before Milio's sustain is online) and a Lulu-favored late game (Polymorph plus knock-up ult). Full-layer side/why must agree per the chart rule.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0/1/2/6].side to Lulu with matching why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no real cooldown numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Milio's Breath of Life (R) is 160/145/130s and Cozy Campfire (W) is 29-21s per the kit file — real numbers make the punish window concrete.
audit.corrected: Cite R's 160-130s cooldown and W's 29-21s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: dosFull[1].t promises 'Poly the carry's steroid window' but the body was generic Lulu trading advice with no Milio-specific interaction; dontsFull[2].t promises W-range chip advice but the body was the generic tradeBad line.
audit.corrected: Ground both in Milio's actual kit: his Q knock-back and his W's zone-only empower.

edits.before: Glitterlance the contacts — the Pix angles double your poke and the chip is constant.
edits.after: You out-range him with E-shield poke and Pix chip — no counter-engage to punish it.

edits.before: E-mark trades begin: Pix on the carry makes every auto a volley.
edits.after: Your Level 2 Q-E spike lands before his shields can answer it.

edits.before: Polymorph online — their engage now has a 1.5-second hole where a champion used to be.
edits.after: You keep the poke lead at 3 — his sustain patterns haven't come fully online yet.

edits.before: Late Lulu deletes dives: poly the assassin, grow the carry, and watch their plan become a squirrel.
edits.after: Your Polymorph and knock-up ult give the cleaner two-item all-in on his carry, tipping it back to you.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. It writes your spacing rules. - W Whimsy is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Breath of Life (R, 160/145/130s CD) cleanses your whole CC chain — force it early, engage after. - Cozy Campfire (W, 29-21s CD) is a big spacing tool, not a poke target. - Warm Hugs (E) has 0.5s CD but only 2 charges — bait one before you commit.

edits.before: Q the doubled angle, E-mark the carry, auto — Pix volleys the chip while your buttons wait for the real question.
edits.after: His Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) knocks back on hit — Polymorph him before he casts it so the peel whiffs.

edits.before: Polymorphing poke out of irritation and meeting the engage with a shrug — the W is the matchup.
edits.after: Cozy Campfire (W) only empowers autos inside its zone — poking it from range wastes your cooldowns.

edits.before: Stack passive Fired Up burns and shields to out-sustain your poke
edits.after: Stack passive Fired Up! burns and shields to out-sustain your poke

notes: suspectNames flag on wants.foe[0] was correct — Milio's passive is 'Fired Up!' with the exclamation mark; fixed to match enemyAbilities.P. missingInteractions anti-heal note (Cozy Campfire/Breath of Life sustain) is already covered by report[8]'s 'Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain' — no edit needed there.
